# AI Daily

## Highlights

A balanced digest with concrete source-backed items.

items.title: OpenAI Responses API adds agent tracing
items.one_liner: Agent developers get clearer tracing for API tool calls and workflow debugging.

items.title: Anthropic releases Claude Code workflow controls
items.one_liner: Engineering teams can constrain tool usage and keep agentic coding flows auditable.

items.title: LangGraph improves durable agent execution
items.one_liner: Open source agent graphs add resumable execution for production software workflows.

items.title: Kubernetes publishes security policy examples
items.one_liner: Infrastructure teams get practical templates for securing AI service deployments.

items.title: GitHub Copilot CLI adds model routing
items.one_liner: Developers can route coding tasks to specialized models from terminal workflows.

items.title: PostgreSQL extension improves vector search plans
items.one_liner: Database developers get better vector query plans for RAG infrastructure workloads.

items.title: New paper evaluates agent tool-use reliability
items.one_liner: The benchmark measures how reliably LLM agents call APIs across software tasks.

items.title: RAG study compares retrieval reranking methods
items.one_liner: The paper shows reranking choices affect factuality in developer documentation search.
